Determines scheduling and consent rules:
CRITICAL : when UpdatePolicy::critical_auto_update is true, bypasses blackout periods, maintenance-window restrictions, and the manual-consent requirement.
NORMAL : follows regular maintenance windows and consent rules.
LOW : treated identically to NORMAL by the scheduler (follows maintenance windows and consent rules); callers may use this tier as a semantic hint, but no special deferral logic is applied automatically.
